contentText:
Billboard joins WWE Superstar couple Dominik Mysterio amd Liv Morgan at her hometown’s Elmwood Park Diner in New Jersey ahead of WrestleMania 42. Liv reflects on her journey to becoming Women’s World Champion, the injuries that kept her from her hometown SummerSlam moment and why she’s not done proving herself. Dominik opens up about growing up in the shadow of a legend, what it took to carve his own identity in WWE and the night he beat AJ Styles.

Together, they discuss what it means to be the most talked-about duo in professional wrestling today, and what they have left to accomplish.

Listen to their Billboard mixtape on S p otify.

Liv Morgan: I can’t believe we’re here.

Dominik Mysterio: This is her call.

Carl Lamarre: Her call?

Liv Morgan: Yeah, I think you’re gonna like it.

Dominik Mysterio: I hope so. It was a good, rough start.

Liv Morgan: I think you’re gonna like it.

Carl Lamarre: Curiosity, where are we exactly, Liv?

Liv Morgan: We are at the Elmwood Park Diner in Park, N.J. You know, tri-state area, I feel like, has a huge diner culture. And so, growing up, I was always here. I haven’t been here in so long,

Carl Lamarre: What’s so long?

Liv Morgan: So long, like, 15 years, at least, yeah, and so, I’m just looking around, soaking it all in.

Carl Lamarre: Oh, my God, you got any recs? I know Dom’s gonna want the chicken tendies.

Dominik Mysterio: I love seeing these ads.

Liv Morgan: I don’t think this is the menu.

Dominik Mysterio: Oh, it’s not?

Liv Morgan: No.

Carl Lamarre: We gotta get you guys.

Liv Morgan: We gotta get menus.

Dominik Mysterio: I didn’t think there was more.

Carl Lamarre: I mean, Liv, I’m curious. What core memories are unlocked when you think of this diner?

Liv Morgan: You know like, how, in, like, A Cinderella Story , how, like, everyone goes to the diner, that’s like, where you hang out. That’s like, what’s that’s like, what it is. It’s, like, everyone comes to Thelma Park diner, and that’s, like, where you go after school, and like, late nights, and that you, like, run into your classmates, and this is where you’d hang out. It was, like, just like Cinderella Story .

Carl Lamarre: Can you take me back to, like, I guess, high school, Liv? Like, what was she like? What was she bumping at the time coming to the diner?

Liv Morgan: Oh, she was ratchet.

Keep watching for more!
